# Controllers

Lit reactive controllers for theme elements and your own components.

Controllers can manage state and behavior related to specific functionality, making it reusable across multiple components.

```js
import { AppStateController, HeadingController, MutationObserverController, NavController, PageWidthController, PopoverController } from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/utils/controllers';
```

- [AppStateController](AppStateController.md): Lit controller that calls back on @ucd-lib/cork-app-state's app-state-update event, if it exists.
- [HeadingController](HeadingController.md): Lit controller that parses a heading in the host's light DOM, for the host element to render in its shadow DOM.
- [MutationObserverController](MutationObserverController.md): Lit controller that attaches a MutationObserver to an element
- [NavController](NavController.md): Lit controller that parses menu markup in the host's light DOM into navItems, for the host element to render in its shadow DOM.
- [PageWidthController](PageWidthController.md): Sets the theme's page width CSS custom property (--page-width), and keeps it current as the window resizes.
- [PopoverController](PopoverController.md): Lit controller that wires up a button and a popover, using the native Popover API.
